contextual_terms.source: \bKukui: Welcome, everyone, to the Alola League's first round - the Battle Royal!
contextual_terms.reason: 明示為瑪納羅大會首輪多人淘汰賽，不是四方皇家對戰。

contextual_terms.source: \bKukui: You're back. The Masked Royal wants to have a battle with you. He told me to tell you to meet him at the Royal Avenue Battle Dome.
contextual_terms.reason: 皇家大道的Battle Royal Dome，不是希爾斯的對戰巨蛋。
